title: Fort Monroe Development Authority Amendment Act 2019

sections.shortTitle: Fort Monroe Development Authority Amendment Act 2019
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XXXIII OF 2019
ACT XXXIII OF 2019
FORT MONROE DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 2019
An Act to amend the Fort Monroe Development
Authority Act, 2016
[Gazette of Punjab Extraordinary,
13th December, 2019]
No.
PAP/Legis-2(31)/2019/2174, dated 13.12.2019.---The Fort Monroe Development Authority (Amendment) Bill 2019, having
been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on November 25, 2019, and
assented to by the Governor of the Punjab on December 10, 2019, is hereby
published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
It
is necessary to amend the Fort Monroe Development Authority Act 2016 (XXIII of
2016) to extend the jurisdiction of the Authority for overall development,
construction, rehabilitation and renovation of Koh-e-Suleman, Tribal Area of
D.G. Khan.
Be
it enacted by Provincial Assembly of the Punjab as follows:
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Act may be cited as the Fort Monroe Development Authority (Amendment) Act,
2019.
(2) It
shall come into force at once.

Authority Act, 2016
[Gazette of Punjab Extraordinary,

No.
PAP/Legis-2(31)/2019/2174, dated 13.12.2019.---The Fort Monroe Development Authority (Amendment) Bill 2019, having
been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on November 25, 2019, and
assented to by the Governor of the Punjab on December 10, 2019, is hereby
published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
It
is necessary to amend the Fort Monroe Development Authority Act 2016 (XXIII of
2016) to extend the jurisdiction of the Authority for overall development,
construction, rehabilitation and renovation of Koh-e-Suleman, Tribal Area of
D.G. Khan.
Be
it enacted by Provincial Assembly of the Punjab as follows:
2. Amendment
in section 1 of Act XXIII of 2016.---In
the Fort Monroe Development Authority Act, 2016 (XXIII of 2016), for brevity
referred to as 'the Act', in section 1:
(a) for
subsection (1), the following shall be substituted:
(1)
This Act may be cited as the Koh-e-Suleman Development Authority Act,
2016"; and
(b) for
subsection (2), the following shall be substituted:
(2)

Rajanpur, as the Government may, by notification in the official gazette,
specify."
